description: This PHP class defines logic hooks for the Accounts module in a SugarCRM-like system. It manages geocoding information updates for account-related entities, including linked Projects, Opportunities, Cases, and Meetings. The class includes methods to update geocode info before saving, after saving related records, and when relationships are added or removed.

classes.name: AccountsJjwg_MapsLogicHook
classes.description: A class containing logic hook methods to update geocode information for Accounts and related entities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the class, retrieving module info for 'jjwg_Maps'.

methods.name: updateGeocodeInfo
methods.description: Updates geocode information for an account bean before saving, if enabled.

methods.name: updateRelatedProjectGeocodeInfo
methods.description: Updates geocode info for related projects after an account save.

methods.name: updateRelatedOpportunitiesGeocodeInfo
methods.description: Updates geocode info for related opportunities after an account save.

methods.name: updateRelatedCasesGeocodeInfo
methods.description: Updates geocode info for related cases after an account save.

methods.name: updateRelatedMeetingsGeocodeInfo
methods.description: Updates geocode info for related meetings after an account save.

methods.name: addRelationship
methods.description: Handles geocoding updates when a relationship is added to an account.

methods.name: deleteRelationship
methods.description: Handles geocoding updates when a relationship is removed from an account.
